description: Allocates a declared transaction price across declared performance obligations by relative standalone selling price, in integer minor units, under the discount handling (spread proportionally, or assigned to declared obligation ids), rounding rule (largest remainder, or round half up with the remainder to the largest obligation) and residual approach (off, or on for one declared obligation) that the caller declares. Returns the allocated amount per obligation, summing exactly to the price, the relative share in basis points, the discount allocated, and flags for a negative or zero residual, a missing standalone selling price, a price below the total with no discount rule, an allocation above a declared cap, and INDETERMINATE when a required fact is missing. It never guesses a standalone selling price. It does not decide the standalone selling prices, does not identify the performance obligations in a contract, and is not an accounting conclusion. Ids and integers only, no free text. Allocated amounts could be consumed by art-265 (amortize_asc606_commissions); no adjacency is declared here.
deferred_reason: New gpu:false node, art-834-asc606-transaction-price-allocator, authored 2026-11-12. No GPU prove has been run and none is proposed by this row: deferred per the section 18 steady-state rule (RIDER-KERNEL.md). Work is integer multiply, divide and remainder distribution over a bounded list (at most 64 obligations); an exec-only cycle measure comes before any booking.
